---
title: ""
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a5
    margin:
      x: 22mm
      y: 28mm
    mainfont: "GenRyuMin2 TW R"
    fontsize: 10pt
lang: zh-TW
---

```{=typst}
#import "_toc-data.typ": toc-data

#set page(numbering: none, footer: none, header: none)

#align(center)[
  #text(font: "GenRyuMin2 TW B", size: 22pt)[傷寒論淺注補正-卷三複習]
  #v(0.8em)
  #text(size: 13pt, fill: luma(45%))[目次]
]

#v(1.5em)

#for part in toc-data [
  text(font: "GenRyuMin2 TW B", size: 12pt)[#part.name]
  v(0.6em)
  for ch in part.chapters [
    grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      gutter: 1em,
      [#ch.title],
      [#if ch.page != none { ch.page } else { text(fill: luma(55%))[規劃中] }]
    )
    if ch.subtitle != none [
      text(size: 8.5pt, fill: luma(45%))[#ch.subtitle]
    ]
    v(0.5em)
  ]
  v(0.8em)
]
```
